MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels relevant because I have recently bought Alexa devices, and a larger display could serve another room, although its older generation reduces my interest.",
    "The Blink doorbell offers a practical new use for my Alexa setup: entryway monitoring connects with my earlier interest in home security."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older Show 5 and Echo Dot repeat functions covered by my newer devices; buying into Alexa does not mean I want older versions of what I already own.",
    "The desktop memory and internal SSD require a specific upgrade project and compatible hardware. My external storage and peripheral purchases do not establish either need.",
    "The headphone adapter, charging cables, earbuds, and Echo Auto address uses I have not shown a current need for, even though they fit broadly with electronics."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be treated as interest in any Alexa device, without enough attention to whether it adds a useful function at home.",
    "My computer accessory purchases seem to be taken as a reason to recommend almost any computer component or connection accessory."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent second-generation Show 5, its stand, and fourth-generation Dot make older versions less useful to me.",
    "My purchases often meet a concrete need, such as a replacement remote battery or a stand for a display I own; a related accessory is appealing when that connection is clear.",
    "Compatibility and intended use matter: owning external storage does not tell you I need an internal drive, and using Alexa at home does not establish a need for it in my car."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but miss the difference between a useful addition, a redundant older device, and an upgrade I have no reason to make."
}
